youtube.baslik: Why was the sixth sound added to the Ling test later? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The Ling six-sound test is a quick listening check made up of the sounds m, oo, ah, ee, sh and s; together, these six sounds roughly cover the frequency range of speech from low to high. Daniel Ling described the test with five sounds in the 1970s; the m sound was added later to cover the low frequencies. The energy of m is mostly in the low frequencies, around 250 to 350 hertz.
